bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Geopolitical escalation (West Asia) impacting energy/freight; Sulfuric acid price correction if Strait of Hormuz opens; Novelis tariff impacts (US-Canada); Delay in captive coal clearances (Chakla, Meenakshi); Global recession slowing aluminum demand; Fire restart delays at Oswego.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident on structural cost advantages and market deficits; Cautious on near-term cost inflation (Q1 +5%) and commodity price volatility (sulfur, coal); Transparent on one-offs (Oswego fire) and restart timelines; Aggressive on capex execution for long-term growth.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Copper EBITDA spike (INR 907cr) is largely transient due to record sulfuric acid prices (TC/RCs negative); Management expects reversion to INR 600-700cr/quarter; Captive coal impact is back-ended (meaningful volumes only FY28); Novelis Bay Minette startup costs ($100-150mn/year) will be classified below EBITDA during 18-24 month ramp.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

latest_quarter.body: Q4 costs +2.5% QoQ; Q1 FY27 costs expected +5% QoQ (furnace oil, CP coke, pitch); Coal prices stable but monsoon risk noted; Sulfuric acid prices parabolic due to West Asia conflict (benefiting copper); Novelis cost savings run-rate now $200mn (target $350-400mn by FY28).
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: India aluminum demand +9% YoY in Q4; Global aluminum market shifting to 1.5mn ton deficit in CY26. Margin: India upstream margins sustained at ~48%; Novelis long-term target $600/ton EBITDA (intact); Copper EBITDA guidance reverted to INR 600-700cr/quarter post-Q4 spike. Order Inflow: Strong demand in automotive, electrical, packaging. Capex/Commissioning: FY27 Capex ~INR 27,000cr (India INR 12,000cr; Novelis $2.3-2.4bn); Bay Minette commercial sales start FY28; Aditya Smelter Phase 1 (180 pots) Dec 2027.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Market tightness driving inventory drawdowns; Global aluminum deficit revised to 1.5mn tons for CY26; India aluminum demand 1.6mn tons in Q4 (+9% YoY); Copper demand 402KT (+10% YoY).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Doubling upstream capacity (Aditya expansion); 4x downstream EBITDA in India by FY30; Novelis 600KT Bay Minette facility (FY28 start); Captive coal mines (Chakla, Meenakshi, Bandha) to flatten cost curve; Specialty alumina shift away from index-linkage.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Hindalco delivered resilient Q4FY26 with India upstream EBITDA/ton at $1,756 and record copper EBITDA of INR 907cr driven by sulfuric acid spikes, offsetting a 51% consolidated PAT drop from Novelis' Oswego fire one-offs. The thesis hinges on capturing the $1.5mn ton global aluminum deficit in CY26 while navigating near-term cost inflation (furnace oil) and executing captive coal ramp-up (FY28) to structurally lower the cost curve.

open.item: Tariff costs were a headwind in FY2025-26, expected to be largely mitigated by end of fiscal year via additional U.S. cold-rolling capacity and improved scrap prices
Aluminium India cost of production in Q3FY26 expected flat to 1% vs Q2 (coal cost eases, CP coke up, planned shutdowns); Q2 COP was ~4% higher than Q1 ex-RPO writeback.

Novelis 600 KT Bay Minette scheduled for completion this year (CY2026); hot mill commissioning next month, all equipment commissioned by back half of CY2026, commercial coils in FY28, full 600 KT run-rate in 18-24 months at EBITDA north of $1,000/ton.

Aditya FRP ramping up; battery enclosure facility at full ramp; Aditya battery foil unit commissioned this quarter; Taloja AC fin facility in commissioning with customer qualifications; specialty alumina precipitate hydrate facility commissioned and under customer approvals.

Copper IGT project (35 KT for AC manufacturing) undergoing customer qualification/trial runs; copper smelter is a few years out (~3 years); battery-grade copper foil to be a smaller capacity in next 2 years given slow Indian battery manufacturing (was FY28).
open.promised: IGT 35 KT; Cu smelter ~3 yrs Kt

open.item: Aluminium India cost of production in Q1FY27 anticipated to rise ~5% vs Q4 (mainly furnace oil, then CP coke and pitch; coal under control); Q4 COP was up ~2.5% vs Q3.

wtt.summary: 40% guidance hit (25 chains); 12/35 projects on-time; 23% theme consistency (info)
wtt.tone_latest: Confident - record India upstream ($1,756/ton) and copper (INR907cr) EBITDA. Management owned the Oswego fire hit (PAT -51%, $53m EBITDA), a third Bay Minette cost step-up context, the ~5% Q1 cost inflation from the West Asia war, and candidly reset the copper guide back to INR600-700cr despite the INR900cr print; also flagged 3 fatalities and slower-than-expected India battery-manufacturing take-up.
